name: project-fish
description: Only the tools in tools/ use this. The game itself needs no install or build step.

scripts.build-pistol: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_pistol9.py -- build/pistol9-source build/pistol9-raw.glb --blend build/pistol9.blend && node tools/finish_pistol9.mjs build/pistol9-raw.glb assets/pistol.glb
scripts.build-pistol-own: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p build && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_pistol.py -- build/arm-base/pistol.json build/pistol-own-raw.glb --blend build/pistol-own.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/pistol-own-raw.glb build/pistol-own.glb --level high
scripts.build-arms: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_arms.py -- build/arm-base build/arms-raw.glb --blend build/arms.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/arms-raw.glb assets/arms.glb --level high
scripts.build-pistol45: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_pistol45.py -- build/m1911-source build/pistol45-raw.glb --blend build/pistol45.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/pistol45-raw.glb assets/pistol45.glb --level high
scripts.build-pistol45-own: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p build && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_pistol45.py -- build/arm-base/pistol45.json build/pistol45-own-raw.glb --blend build/pistol45-own.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/pistol45-own-raw.glb build/pistol45-own.glb --level high
scripts.build-soldier: mkdir -p assets && python3 -I tools/soldier/remove_patch_text.py build/soldier-source/textures/Mark_Helmet1_baseColor.jpeg build/soldier-helmet.jpeg && node tools/soldier/build_soldier.mjs build/soldier-source assets/soldier.glb --helmet build/soldier-helmet.jpeg --size 1024
scripts.build-beretta: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_beretta.py -- build/beretta-source build/beretta-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/beretta-raw.glb assets/beretta.glb --level high
scripts.build-fn502: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_fn502.py -- build/fn502-source build/fn502-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/fn502-raw.glb assets/fn502.glb --level high
scripts.build-hipistol: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_hipistol.py -- build/hipistol-source build/hipistol-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/hipistol-raw.glb assets/hipistol.glb --level high
scripts.build-gear: mkdir -p build assets/gear && python3 -I tools/gear/rub_headset_text.py build/gear-src/tactical_headset_-_game_ready/textures/headset_baseColor.jpeg build/gear-headset.png && node tools/gear/build_gear.mjs build/gear-src assets/soldier.glb assets/gear --headset-texture build/gear-headset.png
scripts.build-x4: mkdir -p build assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_retarget.py -- build/upload-xiri build/x4-raw.glb --arms assets/soldier.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/x4-raw.glb assets/x4.glb --level high
scripts.build-mp7: mkdir -p build assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_retarget.py -- build/upload-mp7 build/mp7-raw.glb --arms assets/soldier.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/mp7-raw.glb assets/mp7.glb --level high
scripts.build-ar15: mkdir -p build assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_retarget.py -- build/upload-ar15 build/ar15-raw.glb --arms assets/soldier.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/ar15-raw.glb assets/ar15.glb --level high
scripts.build-makarov: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_makarov.py -- build/upload-makarov build/makarov-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/makarov-raw.glb assets/makarov.glb --level high
scripts.build-ak74m: mkdir -p build assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_ak74m.py -- build/upload-ak74m build/ak74m-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/ak74m-raw.glb assets/ak74m.glb --level high
scripts.build-ak74u: mkdir -p build assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_ak74u.py -- build/upload-krinkov build/ak74u-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/ak74u-raw.glb assets/ak74u.glb --level high
scripts.build-saps12: mkdir -p build assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_saps12.py -- build/upload-saps12 build/saps12-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/saps12-raw.glb assets/saps12.glb --level high
scripts.build-gun-gloves: mkdir -p assets/gear && node tools/gear/gun_gloves.mjs build/gear-src assets/beretta.glb assets/fn502.glb assets/hipistol.glb assets/makarov.glb assets/ak74m.glb assets/ak74u.glb assets/saps12.glb assets/gear
scripts.build-breakdown: mkdir -p assets/breakdown && node tools/breakdown/build_breakdown.mjs build/upload-ar-breakdown tools/breakdown/ar_slr.json assets/breakdown/ar_slr.glb
scripts.build-breakdown-scar: mkdir -p assets/breakdown && node tools/breakdown/prepare_parts.mjs build/upload-breakdown2 tools/breakdown/scar_l.json build/scar-l-parts && node tools/breakdown/build_breakdown.mjs build/scar-l-parts tools/breakdown/scar_l.json assets/breakdown/scar_l.glb
scripts.build-breakdown-galil: mkdir -p assets/breakdown && node tools/breakdown/bake_rigid.mjs build/upload-breakdown3 tools/breakdown/galil_ace.json build/galil-ace-rigid && node tools/breakdown/build_breakdown.mjs build/galil-ace-rigid tools/breakdown/galil_ace.json assets/breakdown/galil_ace.glb
scripts.build-breakdown-pf9: mkdir -p assets/breakdown && python3 -I tools/breakdown/prepare_pf9.py build/pistol9-source build/pf9-breakdown-src && node tools/breakdown/build_breakdown.mjs build/pf9-breakdown-src tools/breakdown/pf9.json assets/breakdown/pf9.glb
scripts.build-cinematic-clips: mkdir -p assets/cinematic && blender --background --python tools/cinematic/retarget_mixamo.py -- tools/cinematic/clips.json assets/cinematic/soldier_clips.glb
scripts.build-breakdowns: npm run build-breakdown && npm run build-breakdown-scar && npm run build-breakdown-galil && npm run build-breakdown-pf9
scripts.build-models: npm run build-pistol && npm run build-pistol45 && npm run build-beretta && npm run build-fn502 && npm run build-hipistol && npm run build-makarov && npm run build-ak74m && npm run build-ak74u && npm run build-saps12 && npm run build-arms && npm run build-soldier && npm run build-gear && npm run build-gun-gloves && npm run build-x4 && npm run build-mp7 && npm run build-ar15 && npm run build-breakdowns
